# Astronomy Engine

Vendored C/C++ implementation from Astronomy Engine v2.1.19.

Source https://github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy/tree/v2.1.19/source/c

`astronomy.cpp` contains the original `astronomy.c`, renamed for this C++-only CMake project. The upstream source bytes are unchanged. `astronomy.h` is the original header. Both files retain their MIT notices, with the complete license in `LICENSE`.

SHA-256 of astronomy.cpp is `388920479d819713963ffd0f8ab0677944f66c6c94239ceddddd3b0d5d064432`.

SHA-256 of astronomy.h is `83a31011957c2b87e22f0828820f370f1a495aa4d51357bb57d714cde839dc00`.
